column1: # Hudhud's rights register (plan v1, Marhala 12; 25 Nov 2026): every source Hudhud's data, model or answers come from, used or planned.
# kind: own (the owner's or the app's own), ai-output (written by an AI in this project's sessions), outside (anyone else's).
# licence_checked: own; repo (the repository states it); well-established (widely documented, not re-read here); verify (a person
# must read the source's own terms before a release relies on it). status: used / planned / rejected.
# scripts/hudhud_manifest.py --check fails when the data manifest names a source id that is not a row here, or a row is malformed.
